verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents a built-in chat assistant: you describe what you want and it builds the agent or automation, and plain-language edits in the editor rewrite the agent's instructions and tools. Its native AI agents also take a plain-language job, decide the steps and carry them out, with approval gates. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-product assistant, and deeper documentation of what the chat assistant can and cannot do beyond drafting and editing agents and flows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Describe what you want in chat, and Activepieces builds the agent or automation for you.
Write "summarise my unread emails every morning" and you get a drafted agent — a name, instructions, and the tools it needs
describe a change in the editor — "only reply to paying customers" — and the instructions and tools are rewritten for you
You set the goal and choose which apps, flows and files the agent can use. It decides the steps and carries them out. Anything you want to check first waits for your approval.
You write down the job in plain language, give it access to the apps it needs, and it handles the work as it arrives.
